title: Variable count under duality
statement: For every DNF formula $\psi$ over variables indexed by the natural numbers, the variable count of its De Morgan dual equals the variable count of the list of its terms viewed as a CNF formula.
hypotheses_covered: $\psi$ is a DNF formula over natural-number-indexed variables
replaced:
For every DNF formula $\psi$, the CNF obtained from $\psi$ by flipping the polarity of
every literal has the same variable bound as the term list of $\psi$ viewed as a CNF,
where the variable bound of a formula is one more than its largest variable index
(and $0$ if no literal occurs).
